meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: The NM Board of Nursing Nurse Practice Act requires that nurses be supervised and evaluated by a nurse, a dentist, or a physician.; The state may waive the individual school class load requirements (see Appendix B) as established in provisions of state statute.; The Public Education Department (PED) may waive the individual class load and teaching load requirements established in state statute upon demonstration of a viable alternative curricular plan (i.e., Block Scheduling) and a finding by the PED that the plan is in the best interest of the school district and that, on an annual basis, the plan has been presented to and is supported by the affected teaching staff.
meta_state_law_citations_007.evidence: The NM Board of Nursing Nurse Practice Act requires that nurses be supervised and evaluated by a nurse, a dentist, or a physician.
